notes: Shared public sandbox: data changes under other users. The world is the state recorded on 2026-10-11.
No authentication is enforced (000129: bogus bearer -> 200; every call succeeded without credentials).
Every endpoint negotiates Accept: application/xml (Jackson XML) vs JSON (default for */*, text/plain, mixed lists: 000313-000315).
Handlers mirror swagger-petstore's Java data layer (UserData/PetData/OrderData, read from github.com/swagger-api/swagger-petstore) where recordings cannot show internals.
Parameter checks are in the handlers so error bodies follow Accept negotiation; params are declared non-required with on_invalid=coerce on purpose.

Two sandbox faults are modeled as state: USERS_POISONED and TAGS_POISONED in handlers.py (both true, as recorded); FAUXCALL_PETSTORE_HEALTHY=1 switches to the source's healthy behavior (documented from swagger-petstore source, never recorded).

Seeded users (user1..user10, user?10) are public fixtures from UserData.java and are recorded un-pseudonymized (data/privacy.json excludes user fields); passwords stay redacted and render as the server's literal XXXXXXXXXXX (000395).

Server behavior recorded after review: HEAD = GET without body (000429); OPTIONS = generated WADL + Allow (000430; Allow order inferred from that one sample); framework 404/405 as ApiError XML for Accept: application/xml (000426, 000428); YAML via Accept: application/yaml (000431); plain-text errors negotiate JSON when Accept names application/json (000420-000424).

INFERRED (source/docs, not recorded): null or empty JSON/XML bodies -> 500 for pet and user (recorded for order: 000425); missing Content-Type -> 415; uploadImage on a form-created pet (null photoUrls) -> 500; Jackson scalar coercions ('2' -> 2, 2.7 -> 2, numbers -> strings); XML request parsing (wrapped lists detected by element names); form POST/PUT /pet reads only id, name, status (photoUrls/tags/category form fields unverified); YAML spelling of errors and plain strings (left as JSON); inventory XML for status keys that are not XML names.
Real-write budget (25 per endpoint) is nearly spent for POST /pet (23) and DELETE /pet (24): further real write parity runs need a new approval.
